items.title: Lotto e Superenalotto, l’estrazione di oggi 30 ottobre: tutti i numeri vincenti
items.summary: I numeri dei giochi del Lotto, Superenalotto e 10eLotto venivano estratti da anni ogni martedì, giovedì e sabato , dalle ore 20. Da luglio a dicembre 2023 è stata introdotta una quarta estrazione settimanale, il venerdì, per raccogliere fondi in favore delle popolazioni dell’Emilia Romagna colpite dalle alluvioni nel maggio di quell'anno. L'estrazione aggiuntiva del venerdì è poi stata prorogata per tutto il 2024, per il 2025 e per il 2026 e le entrate sono destinate al Fondo per le emergenze nazionali . Oltre a Lotto ed Enalotto è stata disposta un’estrazione aggiuntiva anche per tutti i tipi di giochi connessi, ovvero 10eLotto, SuperStar e Simbolotto . Ecco i numeri fortunati del 30 ottobre 2026.

items.title: Zverev scavalca Sinner in classifica, da lunedì sarà n°1 del tennis
items.summary: AGI - Alexander Zverev sarà il nuovo numero uno del tennis mondiale a partire da lunedì 2 novembre. Il tedesco, vincitore quest'anno del Roland Garros e degli US Open , ha conquistato la vetta del ranking Atp grazie alla vittoria ottenuta giovedì 29 ottobre per 6-4, 7-5 contro l'olandese Tallon Griekspoor negli ottavi di finale del torneo Atp 500 di Vienna . Il successo, ottenuto in un'ora e 35 minuti, gli ha garantito i punti necessari per scavalcare Jannik Sinner , costretto a chiudere anticipatamente la stagione a causa di un infortunio al ginocchio. Zverev avrà almeno 9.450 punti nella prossima classifica, gli stessi dell'azzurro, ma sarà davanti in virtù dei criteri di spareggio dell'Atp. Il 29enne diventerà così il trentesimo giocatore della storia a raggiungere la prima posizione del ranking mondiale, introdotto nel 1973, e il primo tedesco a riuscirci dai tempi di Boris Becker , che occupò la vetta nel 1991. items.title: MAGA: Why Trump's movement is fracturing?
items.summary: As the 2026 midterm elections approach, divisions within the MAGA camp are becoming increasingly visible. From the war in Iran and rising fuel prices to the Epstein files, several of Trump’s decisions are fuelling divisions among his most loyal supporters. Once united by a shared vision of America, MAGA now brings together factions that increasingly disagree over foreign policy, the economy and what “America First” should actually mean. Yet Trump remains the central figure holding this political coalition together – and he is fighting to keep it that way. Why are some of the president’s longtime allies distancing themselves from him? Can MAGA remain united despite these disagreements? And can Trump still mobilise his base ahead of the midterms? 🔍 Our journalist Stella Elgersma breaks down the divisions within the MAGA movement and Donald Trump’s strategy to rally his supporters, once again.

items.title: Oleshky: No access to basic needs, ceasefire offers limited opportunity for humanitarian assistance
items.summary: Catherine Viette is pleased to welcome Jens Schumacher, Field Coordinator in Mykolaiv and Kherson with Solidarity International. Just a few kilometers separate the Ukrainian-controlled city of Kherson from Russian-occupied Oleshky. For civilians caught between military occupation, disrupted essential services and uncertain evacuation arrangements, geographical proximity offers little guarantee of access to life-saving assistance. Schumacher examines the humanitarian implications of a temporary ceasefire around Oleshky, where approximately 2,000 civilians were reported to remain. Although the cessation of attacks has created a limited opportunity for humanitarian operations, the geographical scope of the agreement, the prospects for evacuation and the possibility of sustained humanitarian access remain uncertain.

media.alt: Oleshky: No access to basic needs, ceasefire offers limited opportunity for humanitarian assistance

items.title: ‘Amateur morons’: Flávio Bolsonaro’s short-lived ‘president-elect’ claim met with mockery
items.summary: Brazilian media ridicule defeated candidate over ‘shameful’ absconsion to US and bizarre letter with wrong coat of arms Flávio Bolsonaro had hoped that by Sunday night people would be calling him the next president of Brazil. Instead, the far-right politician’s decision to flee to the US after losing the election and – for 58 minutes – to declare himself “Brazil’s true president-elect” , has made him a laughing stock, with Brazilian newspapers and commentators raining a barrage of scornful adjectives down on the conquered candidate. items.title: Statement by Palazzo Chigi on the Court of Cassation’s ruling on the former Ilva steel plant
items.summary: The Government has no choice but to take note of the ruling by the Court of Cassation on the former Ilva steel plant, which disregards the reasoned conclusions of the Prosecutor General's Office at the same Court. The Government will not back down from its responsibilities, just as it has never backed down from them so far, as confirmed by the decree-law that came into force a few days ago and as reiterated during last Tuesday’s meeting with trade union organisations at Palazzo Chigi. It is clear that this ruling, the content of which requires thorough examination, further complicates a process that has been increasingly difficult and fraught with all manner of obstacles. items.title: President Meloni’s introduction at the press conference following Council of Ministers meeting no. 195
items.summary: Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for being here. I can see there is a high turn-out for a big occasion. The Council of Ministers just approved the 2027 budget law. This is this Government’s fifth budget law and is worth a total of approximately EUR 26 billion. Before going into the details of the main measures, I would first like to say that the guiding philosophy of this budget law is once again to focus the resources available (which aren’t many) on the same priorities we have been pursuing over the last four years: families, the birth rate, cutting taxes, protecting purchasing power, employment incentives, business incentives and citizens’ health. This budget law should therefore not be seen as a standalone measure, but rather as a further building block of a medium-long term strategy that follows the logic of a full term – so, a multi-year path. This strategy is clearly in line with the programme we presented to the Italian people. I must say that I am very satisfied with the consistency, unity and steadfastness we have shown throughout this journey. articles.title: Timeline, Italia in piazza: cortei in oltre 50 città

claims.text: Venerdì di cortei e manifestazioni in oltre 50 città italiane, per lo sciopero generale indetto dai sindacati di base contro il carovita e il riarmo. In piazza, oltre agli studenti che hanno manifestato contro le misure del governo su ordine pubblico e sicurezza, anche i manifestanti pro-Palestina, i centri sociali e altre realtà antagoniste. Tensioni a Roma e Torino. Ospiti in studio, Sara Menafra, vicedirettrice di Open, e Sandro Iacometti di Libero

AGI - Cortei e manifestazioni indetti dall'Usb in più di 50 città italiane in occasione dello sciopero generale contro il carovita e il riarmo. Tensione a Roma per i cortei improvvisati. Occupate per tre ore le tangenziali di Milano e Bologna. La mobilitazione ha toccato in modo massiccio anche Torino, Bologna e Napoli , dove hanno sfilato insieme lavoratori, pensionati, studenti, movimenti per la casa e realtà pro-Palestina. Alla protesta sul territorio nazionale si è aggiunta una giornata di mobilitazione nei porti contro il traffico di armi : un'iniziativa di lotta internazionale lanciata da varie sigle sindacali che coinvolge più di 100 scali in oltre 20 Paesi .
